convert_mistral3_weights_to_hf: convert Mistral3 model weights from original format to HuggingFace transformers format
convert_state_dict_weights: convert a Mistral3 state dict from original checkpoint keys to HuggingFace key format with ROPE permutation
convert_mistral3_config: convert original Mistral3 config JSON to HuggingFace Mistral3Config with text and vision components
build_mistral3_processor: build a PixtralProcessor with converted tokenizer, image processor, and chat template for Mistral3
run_convert_script_cli: run the Mistral3 weight conversion script via CLI with input and output directories
